L30: The cite42†Binance Portfolio Margin Pro Program is a cross-asset margin program that combines the balances in your Margin, USDⓈ-M Futures, and COIN-M Futures Wallets. It supports over 360 cryptocurrencies across these wallets as a single collateral to calculate your account’s equity, margin balance, and maintenance margin requirements.
L31: 
L32: For more information, please refer to cite43†What Is the Binance Portfolio Margin Pro Program? L33: 
L34: Please note:
L35: 
L36: 1. Transfer-in limits
L37:   * There are no transfer-in limits for supported margin assets in Cross-Margin and COIN-M Futures Wallets.
L38:   * The transfer-in limit for the USDⓈ-M Futures Wallet is subject to the maximum deposit rules under Multi-Assets Mode. For more details, please refer to the cite44†Binance Futures Updates Maximum Deposit Limits of Margin Assets for Multi-Assets Mode .
L39: 
L40: 2. Position limits
L41:   * Default position limits in USDⓈ-M and COIN-M Futures are maintained for each symbol on the Binance Portfolio Margin Program.
L42:   * For a comprehensive view of the notional limits for all symbols listed, please refer to the dedicated cite45†USDⓈ-M Futures and cite46†COIN-M Futures tables in the Leverage & Margin section.
L43: 
L44: 3. Collateral rate calculation
L45:   * The USD value of all assets in the Margin, USDⓈ-M Futures, and COIN-M Futures Wallets will be calculated according to the specified collateral rate.
L46:   * For example, if the collateral rate for BTC is 95%, and you have 1 BTC in the Margin Wallet,  1 BTC in the USDⓈ-M Wallet, and 1 BTC in the COIN-M Wallet, your total margin asset value would be 3 BTC * 0.95 = 2.85 BTC.
L47: 
L48: 4. Maximum leverage for Cross Margin
